args.weakness: Fixed 16-byte key reused round-robin by position under a public 20-op program (four seam rotations, chain_add/chain_xor carries, no nonce or length separation). The only public known pair 00010203 -> 926aa3ef spans positions 0-3, so key bytes 4-15 are not derivable from public data and must be recovered by chosen-plaintext probing; positions 16 apart reuse key bytes.
args.attack: Chosen-plaintext differential probing: oracle with a fixed 16-byte base and single-byte-flipped variants to observe per-position output differences, localise key bytes incrementally, then confirm the candidate key across several pairs (analyse pairs) and decrypt the target.
args.predicted: Flips at each position produce deterministic output-difference patterns that fix one key byte per position; a candidate 16-byte key reproduces 00010203 -> 926aa3ef and decrypts c71b783c123518bb4c8718696fb86d23dcfacc9750700df9 to a printable 16-byte ASCII plaintext.
